other_conditions: Must have at least one disability covered under the National Trust Act, 1999 (e.g., Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, Multiple Disabilities) and possess a valid disability certificate.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1,00,000 annual health insurance coverage for disabled persons, covering OPD treatments, surgeries, therapies, alternative medicines, and related expenses.
